verdict.rationale: Authenticator stores cloud backups of account data, so data residency is a fair question for this app. The evidence only shows that users pick which Microsoft personal account holds the backup and that iOS backups go through iCloud. Neither of these is a choice of storage region or residency, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
